title: Symplectic Isomorphism Between Strong-Coupling Criticality and Finite-Strain Bifurcation
summary: The analytical determination of critical scaling in three-dimensional strongly coupled field theories is inherently restricted by the Borel non-summability of perturbative expansions. In this paper, we establish a symplectic isomorphism that maps the infrared dynamics of scalar quantum field theories onto the finite-strain bifurcation mechanics of hyperelastic continua.
